content.value: A band pass digital filter is required to meet the following specification: (16) (i) Complete signal rejection at dc and 250 Hz (ii) A narrow passband centered at 125 Hz (iii) A 3dB bandwidth of 10 Hz.
Assuming a sampling frequency of 500 Hz, obtained the transfer function of the filter, by suitably placing z-plane poles and zeros and its difference equations.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
